oneOf.description: Create a project from a template (rw init).
Schema-only validation of project files (rw validate).
Canonical formatting (rw fmt); CLI only, writes are automatic over MCP.
The evaluated SI model or a subtree (rw eval).
RFC 6902 ops on id paths (rw set); returns the check delta.
Add a component attached to a named anchor (rw add).
Remove a component (rw rm).
Re-attach a component (rw mv); MCP agents use model_patch.
Full check report (rw check); run after every edit.
Render a fixed view to renders/ (rw render).
Search components, materials, and presets (rw lib search).
Show one library item (rw lib show).
Search motors by class, diameter, impulse (rw motor search).
Show one motor and its curve (rw motor show).
Run a sim; returns a cache hit or a job id (rw sim).
Poll a job.
Cancel a job.
Runs per sim with computed status (Complete/Outdated/...).
Compare two runs or a run and an oracle golden (rw diff run).
Semantic model diff keyed by component id (rw diff model).
Steps and revisions (rw history log).
One step and its diff (rw history show).
Compare two versions: model, metrics, visual (rw history compare).
Name a revision Rev NN (rw history tag).
Restore a version as a new step (Revert).
Import an .ork or a motor file (rw import ork, rw motor import).
Export ork/rasp/glb/stl/csv (rw export).
A published JSON Schema by name (rw schema).
Liquid engine sizing and performance (rw engine design).
Tank and feed simulation; returns a job (rw engine sim).
Import a CFD point dataset (R6.15).
Search thrustcurve.org for motors (network; only when the user asks).
Download a motor file from thrustcurve.org into lib/motors/ (network).

files.description: Files to validate; empty = all project files.

check.description: Report only; exit 1 when a file would change.

path.description: JSON pointer into the evaluated model (`/components/3`); absent = whole model.

PatchOp.description:
One RFC 6902 operation. `path` and `from` are JSON pointers into the source
model keyed by id (`/c/<id>/<field>`, `/params/<name>/value`).

name.description: Display name; defaults to the id.

attach.description: Placement relative to a parent anchor. Absent only on the first body component.

override.description: Mass, CG, and CD overrides (flagged in the check report).

cut.description: `true`: this component subtracts material from its parent (BOSL2 `diff()`).

import.description: Import provenance (`.ork` UUID), kept for event mapping.

Component.description: One `[c.<id>]` table. Common fields first; the `type` key selects the kind.

at.description: Own anchor that lands on `to`; default is the mirrored anchor.

cg.description: CG measured from this component's fore end.

subtree.description: `true`: the override replaces the whole subtree's values.

Finish.description: Surface finish: a named preset or an explicit roughness.

Appearance.description: Renderer appearance (R2.5). Presets map to PBR materials.

capped.description: Closed end (bulkhead) at the shoulder's free end.

Shoulder.description: A shoulder on a nose cone or transition.

shape_param.description: Power exponent, Haack C, or parabolic K (shape-dependent).

offset.description: Offset of the tab's fore edge from the root leading edge, +aft.

FinTab.description: A fin tab through the body wall.

sweep.description: Leading-edge sweep length (root LE to tip LE, axial).

points.description: Planform `[x, y]` points from the root LE (x +aft, y outward), root first and last on y = 0.

motor_mount.description: Accepts a motor (configs assign one by this component's id).

overhang.description: Motor overhang past the aft end.

od.description: Defaults to the parent's inner diameter.
Outer diameter of the base and the flange.

height.description: Total height above the body surface.

base_height.description: Height of the base at the body surface (default `height / 4`).

flange_height.description: Height of the flange at the outer face (default `height / 4`).

line_material.description: Shroud-line material (needs a `line_density`); the canopy uses `material`.

fraction.description: Fill as a fraction of internal volume, or give `volume`.

Tank.description: A propellant tank (inner component) used by liquid engines (R2.5, R2.7).

recursive.description: Also remove components attached to it (otherwise they error).

View.description: 2D views (Rust SVG/PNG, deterministic) and 3D views (shared TS renderer).

oneOf.description: Flat check materials (default for headless and goldens).

force.description: Re-run even on a cache hit.

mc.description: Monte Carlo sample count (large counts need approval).

thread.description: Filter to one thread (`cli`, `ui`, a thread id).

breakdown.description:
Also return the per-component mass and CG rows
(`mass.components.<id>.mass|cg`) and the per-component aero terms
(`aero.terms.<id>.cna|cp`) in `breakdown`.

number.description:
Revision number (`Rev NN`); default: one above the highest. An
explicit number must exceed every existing one (e.g. continuing a
numbering that started outside RocketWright).

path.description: Output path, project-relative (or absolute inside the project).

allow_outside.description:
Allow a path outside the project (absolute or `..`); the gated
approval names the path. Default: the path must stay inside.

path.description:
A CSV file (one step) or a directory of `<prefix>_t<seconds>.csv`
steps (R6.15); absolute or relative to the project.

study.description: Dataset id (`[a-z0-9_-]`); default: the file prefix before `_t<s>`.

query.description:
Designation or common name (`C6`, `H128W`); a leading word may name
the manufacturer (`Estes C6`). A delay suffix (`C6-5`) is ignored.

limit.description: Most motors to return (default 20, at most 100).

ThrustcurveSearchIn.description:
Search thrustcurve.org's motor database. The only network access in
RocketWright, and only when the user asks for it.

motor.description:
A ThrustCurve motor id (from `thrustcurve_search`), or a designation
(`C6`, `Estes C6-5`) that matches exactly one motor.

ThrustcurveFetchIn.description:
Download one motor's data file from thrustcurve.org into `lib/motors/`
(as `import_file` does with a local file), recording its sha256 and its
source under `rocketwright.toml [lib]`.

oneOf.description: RASP `.eng`.
RockSim `.rse` (carries mass and CG per sample).
